title: Satisfaction by propagated labels
statement: Let $q$ be a positive integer and let $G$ be a finite unique game with a nonempty set of variables and a nonempty set of constraints. Each constraint joins two distinct variables, carries a permutation of the $q$ labels, and every variable occurs in some constraint. If $G$ admits a labeling satisfying every constraint, then the labeling obtained by propagating labels from component roots also satisfies every constraint.
hypotheses_covered: The variable set is finite and nonempty
The constraint set is finite and nonempty
Each constraint carries a permutation of the labels
Every variable participates in a constraint
